title: PHP shell execution function — review required
description: shell_exec/system/passthru/proc_open pass strings to an OS shell, where metacharacters in attacker-influenced input become command injection. This lexical rule cannot prove taint — treat every hit as review-required, not as proven exploitable.
remediation: Avoid shell functions: use PHP's native APIs (filesystem, process with argument arrays) instead. If a shell call is unavoidable, escape every dynamic fragment with escapeshellarg() and never interpolate input.
limitation: Lexical, line-based, no dataflow: any listed function call matches, including static safe commands. Backtick execution and popen with dynamic modes are out of scope.
